Elaine (PM): quick sync — we need to lock down launch criteria for the console observability bundle (dashboards + tracing hooks + cost breakdown + error analytics). Customer asks are stacking up. who can take the tradeoff list?
Devon (Eng): I can take batching/telemetry limits. need to know sampling defaults and max token retention for traces.
Chris (SRE): +1. also need SLOs for trace ingestion and dashboard query latency. we should define acceptance thresholds.
Elaine (PM): proposal: must-have: 1) dashboard templates for top-10 customer queries, 2) tracing hooks for hot-paths + 5 custom spans, 3) cost breakdown surface with per-route cost, 4) error analytics with tagging and root-cause links. optional: anomaly alerts.
Lara (Backend): technically 5 custom spans per service is doable, but KV cache plumbing needs one sprint. quantization of logs for cost UI will need schema changes.
Matt (Design): for dashboards we need a lightweight template gallery + one-click apply. can we scope to two gallery templates at GA? customers want quick wins.
Samir (Product): can we make rollout gated by canary + opt-in beta? enterprise customers need opt-out controls and data residency notes.
Elaine (PM): yes — rollout plan: internal canary -> customer beta (opt-in) -> GA. acceptance: beta must show <200ms median dashboard load, traces sampled >95% of hot-path requests, and cost breakdown accuracy within 5%.
Devon (Eng): sampling >95% for hot-paths — that's ambiguous. define "hot-path" as requests with p99 latency above X or routes flagged by owners. also we should include a fallback short-circuit when ingestion quota spikes.
Chris (SRE): ops constraints: we need throttles in place to protect serving. recommend soft limits + auto-fallback to summary traces.
Lara (Backend): implementation note: adding throttles will change billing signals. Product needs to sign off on how throttled traces show in cost UI.
Samir (Product): agreed — we should surface "throttled" as a distinct state in the cost table and in the error analytics so customers understand noise.
Matt (Design): UX ask: show sample size and sampling rate per chart. customers asked for transparency. small mock attached (link) -> https://figma.redwood/example-observe-gallery
Elaine (PM): action items: Devon -> sampling defaults + throttle behavior doc by EOD Friday. Lara -> backend impact doc (billing + schema) by Monday. Matt -> gallery mock v1 by Friday. Chris -> SLO proposal and infra limits by Monday. Samir -> beta customer list + opt-in flow proposal. I'll consolidate.
Devon (Eng): quick note: here's a sample config snippet for sampling we discussed:
```
tracing:
  default_sample_rate: 0.05
  hot_path_override: 0.95
  retention_days: 7
  throttle_policy:
    enabled: true
    burst_limit: 10000
    fallback: summary_traces
```
Devon (Eng): we'll need product input on default_sample_rate. 5% default reduces cost but may under-index some faults.
Samir (Product): customer ask: enterprise A wants 14d retention and per-tenant sampling override. can we add that to dedicated/private roadmap instead of hosted GA?
Chris (SRE): per-tenant overrides are fine on Dedicated, must land guardrails for Hosted. recommend admin role check and soft quotas.
Elaine (PM): launch rubric reminder: to GA we need 3 beta customers confirming observability UX + performance, docs + migration guide, and alerting templates. if any of the MUST items fail, we hold GA.
Lara (Backend): estimate: core tracing hooks + cost surface MVP -> 2 sprints. dashboards template + gallery -> 1 sprint. error analytics (tagging + RCA links) -> 2 sprints. might overlap.
Matt (Design): can we compress gallery to a 3-day design sprint to unblock devs? I can do that if we prioritize templates.
Devon (Eng): note on metrics: dashboard queries hitting queries-per-second > 500 will need pre-aggregation. include async rollup plan.
Chris (SRE): ops-bot just reported deploy queue length spike earlier — might impact the canary window. ops-bot: deploy-queue: 18 waiting (avg wait 4m).
Elaine (PM): thanks — we'll keep canary windows wider this week.
Samir (Product): customer ask tracker: I'll add enterprise A and B and a midmarket C. will send invites for beta next week.
Devon (Eng): I'll post a short doc in #eng-runtime with the sampling math and cost estimates.
Elaine (PM): ok team — collate everything in the roadmap doc. I'll schedule a 30m sync after docs land. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
Matt (Design): noted.
Chris (SRE): SLO doc will include rollback criteria.
Elaine (PM): last call: anything else?
Samir (Product): one ask — expose a simple "estimated $ / route" for top 10 routes at GA. marketing likes that.
Lara (Backend): we can expose estimates with caveat badges.
Elaine (PM): perfect. closing thread, will follow up with consolidated plan. :tada:
